name: Fog Machine
desc: Low banks of haze roll horizontally across the stage floor, injecting expanding puffs on section changes and thinning out when the music peaks.

hue.doc: fog tint hue (210=cold blue-grey; used as heat base in thermal)

cover.doc: vertical extent of the fog band

style.doc: volumetric=soft translucent banks / sumi=ink-wash tonal smoke with dry-brush tendrils / noir=chiaroscuro dark mass + raking light edge / thermal=false-color heat ramp (abstract) / halftone=dot-matrix cluster field (abstract)
